scenes.narration: Hare zipped around the meadow. Tortoise smiled. Let's race to the old oak tree, she said.
scenes.visual_description: Both wait at a colorful sunny forest race starting line across one dirt path.

scenes.narration: Off they went! Hare bounced far ahead, while Tortoise took one small, careful step after another.
scenes.visual_description: Hare races up the winding path while Tortoise follows steadily.

scenes.narration: I have plenty of time, thought Hare. He stretched beneath a shady tree and fell asleep.
scenes.visual_description: Hare naps beneath a leafy tree beside the trail.

scenes.narration: Tortoise kept going, past flowers and over a little hill. Every step brought the finish closer.
scenes.visual_description: Tortoise climbs a flower-covered hill, keeping her eyes on the goal.

scenes.narration: Hare woke too late! Tortoise reached the oak first. Keep trying, friends. Small steps can achieve big things.
scenes.visual_description: At the oak tree, the friends celebrate Tortoise's patient effort.
